question: Is Pluto a planet according to the IAU?
intent: Definition/version conflict. IAU 2006 resolution vs historical planet status.

consequentialClaims.text: Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet according to the IAU.
consequentialClaims.title: Press Release in English, August 24, 2006 - IAU XXVIth General Assembly
consequentialClaims.span: Pluto is a "dwarf planet" by the above definition and is recognized as the prototype of a new category of trans-Neptunian objects.

conflict.note: The cited 2006 IAU resolution is the official answer. The report does not separately quote the pre-2006 planet listing or explain the definition change as a dated conflict between sources.

userRepairRequired: None for the asked IAU yes/no. A stronger J6 would cite both the 2006 resolution and a pre-2006 planet catalog and explain the date/definition split.
